messages:
maria: Hey team — auditor asked for 'provenance samples' for a subset of KMS-encrypted artifact access and session replays. Need to confirm what we can provide and a playbook for playback. Any volunteers for data extraction?

Dan: I can pull S3 access logs + KMS decrypt events. Which timeframe and sample size?

maria: Auditor asked for 3 examples per service, spanning last fiscal quarter (2025-01-01 to 2025-03-31), plus one simulated replay showing key origination -> usage. Keep sample size small and redacted.

lucy: We'll also need a control map linking each example to SOC2/CC6.1 and ISO A.12.4.1 controls. I'll draft that mapping and a short narrative per sample.

Dan: For logs I'll correlate CloudTrail KMS events and S3 access logs. Example Splunk query I plan to run:
```
index=cloudtrail (eventName=Decrypt OR eventName=GenerateDataKey) | table _time userIdentity.sessionContext awsRegion requestParameters keyId
```
Then join with s3 access events by requestParameters.requestId.

auditor_bot: Reminder: exported samples must include chain-of-custody metadata and SHA256 for each artifact. Do not include plaintext key material.

maria: Good call. We'll attach checksums + selection rationale (why chosen, who requested, escalation notes).

Dan: For the simulated replay: we will not expose real keys. Plan: 1) snapshot logs, 2) spin ephemeral role in isolated account, 3) replace key identifiers with stubs, 4) run playback tooling to demonstrate flow, 5) capture video + hashes of replayed artifacts.

lucy: Also include evidence of retention/immutability: S3 object lock metadata, version IDs, and a screenshot of the retention policy for the bucket.

maria: Need someone to package the bundle and upload with manifest. Deadline EOD Wed. @dan volunteer? :+1:

Dan: I'll own packaging. Will push bundle to s3://redwood-audit/auditor-deliveries/5870012345/ and DM a presigned link once uploaded.

auditor_bot: Manifest uploaded. s3://redwood-audit/auditor-deliveries/5870012345/manifest.json (presigned link sent to auditor contact). Fieldwork lead: please confirm receipt and whether additional context is required.
